updateNotes: New: the Movies and Series banner plays a trailer of the highlighted title, with sound (change it under Settings > Player > Banner trailer). Much better catch-up: jump anywhere in a replayed programme, start over, previous and next programme, a Fix time button, replay marks in the guide, and replays carry on where you left off. Cleaner player controls. Sports Hub finds more event channels. A clearer message when a channel needs a VPN. New TV banner and notification icon.
